package sample

import nextloggers "github.com/ORESoftware/next-loggers.ts/sdk/go"

type service struct {
	logger *nextloggers.Logger
}

func run(other *otherLogger) {
	logger := nextloggers.NewLogger(nextloggers.Options{AppName: "checkout"})

	logger.Info("delivered").Send()                       // ok
	logger.Warn("delivered").NotOtel().Send()             // ok
	logger.Error("delivered").UseOtel().SendWithStore(false) // ok

	logger.Info("dropped")                                // want: missing send
	logger.Warn("dropped").AddFields(nil)                 // want: missing send
	logger.Error("dropped").UseOtel()                     // want: missing send

	event := logger.Info("assigned")
	event.Send()

	other.Info("not a next-loggers call")
}

func (s *service) handle() {
	s.logger.Debug("field logger dropped") // want: missing send
	s.logger.Debug("field logger sent").Send()
}
